aquamatch_chla.source_name: AquaMatch Chlorophyll a Data from Water Quality Portal: ~1970-2024

acquisition.citation: Brousil, M.R., M.F. Meyer, K. Willi, B.G. Steele, J. De La Torre, and M.R. Ross. 2024. AquaMatch Chlorophyll a Data from Water Quality Portal: ~1970-2024 ver 2. Environmental Data Initiative.

nla.source_name: EPA National Lakes Assessment survey data

acquisition.data_download_tool: NARS Data Download Tool linked from the EPA landing page
acquisition.recommended_citation_template: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency. [survey report year]. National Aquatic Resource Surveys. National Lakes Assessment [survey year] (data and metadata files). Available from U.S. EPA web page: https://www.epa.gov/national-aquatic-resource-surveys/data-national-aquatic-resource-surveys. Date accessed: 2026-05-18.

terms_review.summary: EPA's NARS data page provides survey data and companion metadata as downloadable CSV/TXT files and recommends citing the data by survey name, survey year, report year, page URL, and access date. This project keeps the local raw mirror under DVC/GCS and publishes provenance, citations, hashes, pointer files, and derived summaries.
terms_review.redistribution_policy: Treat the EPA-hosted files as publicly downloadable source data, but do not commit the local raw mirror as Git blobs. Keep raw files in authorized DVC/GCS storage and direct public readers to the EPA source page and citation guidance.

wqp.source_name: Water Quality Portal WQX3 lake/reservoir/impoundment export

terms_review.summary: EPA documents WQP as a public download/retrieval warehouse combining WQX submissions with USGS data from many federal, state, tribal, local, academic, NGO, and other organizations. The project therefore treats WQP as publicly downloadable but not as a single-license raw redistribution package.
terms_review.redistribution_policy: Keep the full raw mirror in authorized DVC/GCS storage for reproducibility, not as public Git blobs. Public Git may include acquisition scripts, query filters, source metadata, manifests, SHA-256 hashes, DVC pointers, and derived summaries, but not the full WQP raw export as Git blobs.
